title: News strip under the hero keeps rotating and won't sit still
what_happened: The strip under the big photo flips between five stories every few seconds (feedback request, bulletin, stories). Text fades in and out while I'm reading, and I couldn't see a pause control. It's distracting when I'm trying to scan the page fast.
expected: A static list of highlights, or a rotation that stops when I hover or when I'm about to click.

title: "What We Do" dropdown stays open and covers the page while I read
what_happened: After I picked Cultural Connections, the dropdown stayed open over the page title, and it was still covering the text after I scrolled.
expected: The menu closes once I've picked a page.

title: Testimonial is pale text on a pale blue panel
what_happened: The Georgia State University faculty quote, which is the most useful thing on the page for someone like me, is white italic text on light blue. The name line underneath is almost invisible.
expected: Dark text, or a photo with a dark overlay, so a peer's quote is easy to read.

title: Testimonial cards show huge blank boxes with a single letter where photos should be
what_happened: Before the University of Virginia quote there was a screen-tall pale box with only a "T" in it, and the earlier quote had an "AL" placeholder. It looks like the images didn't load, and I had to scroll through empty space to reach the text.
expected: Real photos, or small initials badges that don't take up a full screen.

title: No price, trip length, dates, group size or safety/insurance info anywhere on the Cultural Connections page
what_happened: I read the whole Cultural Connections page, including a six-question FAQ. It tells me where (Nicaragua, Dominican Republic), what's included (projects, homestays, meals, expert-led sessions) and that universities are welcome. It says nothing about cost, how many days a trip lasts, sample dates, group size limits, safety protocols, medical or travel insurance, or who supervises students. The FAQ answers "is voluntourism ethical" but not "how much does it cost" or "is it safe".
expected: For a university coordinator: a sample itinerary (for example "7–10 days"), a per-person price range, typical group size, and a short safety/lodging/insurance section, or a downloadable one-page program sheet.

title: FAQ says "reach out through our contact page" but doesn't link to it
what_happened: The answer to "How can I volunteer…" says the best first step is the contact page, but the words aren't a link and the top menu has no "Contact" item.
expected: "contact page" is a link, ideally to a group or university inquiry form.

title: "Partnership Information" goes to a page about existing partners, not about how to become one
what_happened: On Cultural Connections, the Academic Partners card's "Partnership Information" button took me to "Our Partners" under Who We Are. It shows partner counts (20+ academic partners) but nothing about how a university sets up a program: no length, cost, process or contact person. The menu even jumped from What We Do to Who We Are.
expected: A page for prospective academic partners: sample program length, cost range, safety/insurance, a named coordinator and an inquiry form.
